cards.front: What is the money in Indonesia called?
cards.back: Rupiah. We write it as Rp.
cards.say: What is the money in Indonesia called? Rupiah. We write it as R, P.

cards.front: What is a coin?
cards.back: A small, round piece of metal money, such as Rp 500.
cards.say: What is a coin? A small, round piece of metal money, such as five hundred rupiah.

cards.front: What is a note?
cards.back: A piece of paper money, such as Rp 5.000.
cards.say: What is a note? A piece of paper money, such as five thousand rupiah.

cards.front: Which is worth more: Rp 1.000 or Rp 500?
cards.back: Rp 1.000. Two Rp 500 coins make Rp 1.000.
cards.say: Which is worth more: one thousand rupiah or five hundred rupiah? One thousand rupiah. Two five hundred rupiah coins make one thousand rupiah.

cards.front: Which is worth more: Rp 200 or Rp 100?
cards.say: Which is worth more: two hundred rupiah or one hundred rupiah? Two hundred rupiah. It is double one hundred rupiah.
One hundred rupiah plus one hundred rupiah equals two hundred rupiah.
Two hundred rupiah plus two hundred rupiah equals four hundred rupiah.
Five hundred rupiah plus five hundred rupiah equals one thousand rupiah.
One thousand rupiah plus one thousand rupiah equals two thousand rupiah.
Two thousand rupiah plus one thousand rupiah equals three thousand rupiah.
Two thousand rupiah plus two thousand rupiah equals four thousand rupiah.
Five thousand rupiah plus five thousand rupiah equals ten thousand rupiah.
Five thousand rupiah plus two thousand rupiah equals seven thousand rupiah.

cards.front: Rp 10.000 is the same as how many Rp 5.000 notes?
cards.say: Ten thousand rupiah is the same as how many five thousand rupiah notes? Two notes.

cards.front: How many Rp 100 coins make Rp 1.000?
cards.say: How many one hundred rupiah coins make one thousand rupiah? Ten coins.

cards.front: How many Rp 500 coins make Rp 1.000?
cards.say: How many five hundred rupiah coins make one thousand rupiah? Two coins.

cards.front: How many Rp 1.000 notes make Rp 2.000?
cards.say: How many one thousand rupiah notes make two thousand rupiah? Two notes.

cards.front: A pencil costs Rp 2.000. You pay Rp 5.000. What is your change?
cards.back: Rp 3.000. 5 thousand take away 2 thousand is 3 thousand.
cards.say: A pencil costs two thousand rupiah. You pay five thousand rupiah. What is your change? Three thousand rupiah. Five thousand take away two thousand is three thousand.

cards.front: A sweet costs Rp 500. You buy 2 sweets. How much do you pay?
cards.say: A sweet costs five hundred rupiah. You buy two sweets. How much? One thousand rupiah.

cards.front: A ball costs Rp 1.000. You pay Rp 2.000. What is your change?
cards.say: A ball costs one thousand rupiah. You pay two thousand rupiah. What is your change? One thousand rupiah.

cards.front: A biscuit costs Rp 1.000. A drink costs Rp 3.000. What is the total?
cards.say: A biscuit costs one thousand rupiah. A drink costs three thousand rupiah. What is the total? Four thousand rupiah.

cards.front: Which note is worth more: Rp 10.000 or Rp 5.000?
cards.say: Which note is worth more: ten thousand rupiah or five thousand rupiah? Ten thousand rupiah. It is double five thousand rupiah.

cards.front: Can you buy a Rp 3.000 snack with a Rp 2.000 note?
cards.back: No. Rp 2.000 is less than Rp 3.000.
cards.say: Can you buy a three thousand rupiah snack with a two thousand rupiah note? No. Two thousand rupiah is less than three thousand rupiah.

cards.front: Rp 1.000 take away Rp 500
cards.say: One thousand rupiah take away five hundred rupiah equals five hundred rupiah.
